title: bete ke qatilon se
body:
Haye akbar, haye akbar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ayna ayna ali akbar?
Ayna ayna ali akbar?
<<MINI>>
Haye akbar, haye akbar
Haye akbar, haye akbar
Bete ke qatilo'n se, ek baap puchta hai..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
Koi mujhe bata de, laasha kaha'n pada hai
<<MINI>>
akbar mera kaha'n hai?
Bete ke qatilo'n se, ek baap puchta hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Dil par meri bahan ke khanjar chala diya hai
kisne hamare ghar ka suraj bujha diya hai
din mein andhera meri, ankho'n mein hogaya hai
<<MINI>>
akbar mera kaha'n hai?
Bete ke qatilo'n se, ek baap puchta hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Pyaase ko bewatan ko, itna to mat satao
chal chalke thak gaya hu, logo mujhe batao
ab aur kitna baaqi, maqtal ka fasla hai
<<MINI>>
akbar mera kaha'n hai?
Bete ke qatilo'n se, ek baap puchta hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ghazi ko tumne maara, mai chup raha na bola
akbar ko maara naiza, mai chup raha na bola
tumse sawaal karlu, itna to haq mera hai
<<MINI>>
akbar mera kaha'n hai?
Bete ke qatilo'n se, ek baap puchta hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Maa ko baghair dekhe, beta guzar na jaye
pohcha do mujhko jaldi, mazloom marr na jaye
awaaz aa rahi hai, wo hichki le raha hai
<<MINI>>
akbar mera kaha'n hai?
Bete ke qatilo'n se, ek baap puchta hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Khaime se jab chala tha, kehti thi meri behna
pamaal ho na jaye, akbar ki laash bhaiyya
kaano mein mere ab tak, baaqi wahi sadaa hai
<<MINI>>
akbar mera kaha'n hai?
Bete ke qatilo'n se, ek baap puchta hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Dil baitha jaa raha hai, rukte nahi hai aasu
jungle se aa rhi hai, uske lahu ki khushbu
kuch saanse chal rahi hai, ya sher chal basaa hai
<<MINI>>
akbar mera kaha'n hai?
Bete ke qatilo'n se, ek baap puchta hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Aulad e Mustafa se kis tarha phir gaye ho
kadyal jawa'n ka marna aasa'n samajh rahe ho
tumlog has rahe ho, dil mera ro raha hai
<<MINI>>
akbar mera kaha'n hai?
Bete ke qatilo'n se, ek baap puchta hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Ehle haram ki akbar, ummeed akhri hai
kehti hai ye zaeefi, mera asaa yehi hai
ab do qadam bhi chalna, dushwar ho gaya hai
<<MINI>>
akbar mera kaha'n hai?
Bete ke qatilo'n se, ek baap puchta hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Ghurbat hai aur takallum ibn e shahe najaf hai
koi bola is taraf hai, koi bola us taraf hai
akhir pukare maula, ghazi tumhe pata hai
<<MINI>>
akbar mera kaha'n hai?
Bete ke qatilo'n se, ek baap puchta hai..(2)
Haye akbar, haye akbar..
